relationships.public_claim: The backsplash display was an integrated infrastructure component of Hyphen's makeline.
Digi 003 and Digi 003 Rack were sibling interface variants, with the rack model omitting the control surface.
Disk cartridges provided the expandable storage modules inside the KSYSTEM-120 Mini System.
Hyphen's dispenser set was configured as part of each automated makeline.
M300 and M500 were sibling players on Kaleidescape's named M-Class platform.
Mbox 2 Mini adapted the standard Mbox 2 into a smaller, reduced-feature USB Pro Tools interface.
Mbox 2 Pro adapted the Mbox 2 design around FireWire, higher sample rates, and expanded I/O.
Mbox 2 succeeded the original Mbox, retaining its portable Pro Tools interface role while adding new I/O and controls.
The portion-cup fill module was one of the configurable modules in Hyphen's makeline.
Digi 003 Rack replaced Digi 002 Rack while retaining the rackmount Pro Tools LE interface role.
The Kaleidescape remote was included as an input component of the KSYSTEM-120 Mini System.
Cortez was specified as a wireless input device for the WebTV Galaxy gateway.
WebTV Galaxy's gateway enclosure was specified as a design evolution related to Mercury.
WebTV Galaxy and Xbox were both specified as devices on the named HomeNet platform.
Titan was specified as a portal-node component of the WebTV Galaxy HomeNet system.
